meta.description: Merged research dependency graph (12 lines). Edges run prerequisite -> dependent. proposed_year = target_year unless listed in YEAR_ADJUSTMENTS.md. earliest_feasible_year = critical path over requires_all/requires_any using research_years, every line researched continuously.

conditions_schema.resources_known: list of in-game resource names (all required)
conditions_schema.resources_unmapped: source names with no in-game resource (not enforced)

meta.pacing_rule: impossible: critical-path EF > max(band_high, proposed_year); serial_overrun: serial_line_finish_year > that bound; under_gated: band_low>=100 and critical-path EF < 10% of band_low. serial_line_finish_year = one project at a time per line, items taken in proposed_year order, waiting on cross-line prerequisites
